svg.title: MacLink setup flow
svg.desc: Four-step setup with Mac registration, one-time permissions, permanent link creation and remote browser access.

path.aria-label: GETTING STARTED
Set up once. Reconnect with your link.
The Mac runs a native Connector; the remote user only needs a supported browser.
Register your Mac
Sign in with Google at www.maclink.cloud.
Add your Mac; download the DMG and device key.
Keep the device key on your own Mac.
Install and connect
Install the DMG app in Applications and launch it.
Import the device key in Settings.
Allow Screen Recording and Device control.
Create a permanent link
Confirm your Mac shows Online.
Create a view-only or control access link.
Share only with people you authorize.
Connect in the browser
Open the link in a compatible browser.
Enter the host's Google sign-in email.
Choose a connection mode and quality.
Future access needs no repeated approval on the Mac.
Keep the Mac awake, logged in, online and running the Connector with permissions enabled.
Optional: enable Start MacLink at login in Settings.
The owner can revoke access links or stop remote access at any time.
